releases.name: Version 0.1.6
releases.body:
* Added a DLC check so the mod no longer breaks without DLC!! (i'm so sorry)
* Fixed starfield disappearing over time
* Made Chert no longer panic over nonexistent supernovae

* Reduced list of anglerfish errors on start
* Removed incorrectly added parts on OPC barrel
releases.bodyZh:
* 添加了DLC检查，因此即使没有DLC模组也不会崩溃！！（我真的很抱歉）
* 修复了星空随时间消失的问题
* 使切特不再对不存在的超新星感到恐慌

* 减少了开始时角鱼错误的列表
* 删除了OPC桶上错误添加的部分

releases.name: Version 0.1.4
releases.body:
Made Hourglass Twins' water exchange loop infinitely
Fixed a constant error caused by a shader on the HGT getting angry about the missing sand
Fixed the ice blocking the Interloper's entrance not being hidden + redundant gm notification volumes
Fixed a light in a module on the OPC being keeploaded, which looked weird from far away
Fixed some low gravity volumes on the Hanging City highways
Added a landing pad to the Sun Station and slapped the Hotshot achievement thing on there (disclaimer: no idea if it works!!)

NOTE: This mod disables the supernova and the loop ending on its own. You will be free to explore as long as you wish, but you will need to find death yourself to save and restart the star system!
releases.bodyZh:
制作沙漏双星的交换循环无限循环
修复由HGT上的着色器因缺少沙子而生气导致的常数错误
修复冰块阻挡闯入者入口未隐藏+冗余的gm通知体积
修复OPC上一个模块中的灯光被持续加载，从远处看很奇怪
修复悬挂城高速公路上的低重力体积
为太阳站添加了着陆平台，并在上面贴上了Hotshot成就（免责声明：不知道是否有效！！）

注意：此模组禁用了超新星和循环自动结束。只要你想探索多久都可以自由探索，但你需要自己找到死亡来保存和重启星系！
